focus_area_title: Plan How You're Going to Tackle Your Priorities
content_text_body:
* Agree what you want to do to make things better. Keep the actions simple and focused, with concrete outcomes; this is not a time to add a long list of new initiatives to everyone's plate.

* Decide when and how you'll check in on progress, to keep you all focused and excited.

* If there is going to be another rapid pulse check soon, build your timelines and actions on that basis and let the team know.

* Consider what resources may be needed - budget, reallocation of resources, outside help.

* Above all, keep it simple. Don't overcommit and underdeliver.
